audit.limits: Custom command matches are lexical, including data and dormant code; review before transfer. Embedded helper presence does not prove invocation resolution. PATH tools, dynamic commands, transitive third-party dependencies, repositories, theme assets and effective configuration require further proof. Whole-line provenance comments/licenses/tests/docs are excluded; inline comments and compatibility data may need review.

Independent editor integration with preserved user data
Inspected system settings/services/hooks classified and required behavior delivered by pinned native packages

checks: theme helper executes with its packaged Python interpreter
IPC resolves the installed shell with packaged runtime tools
menu selection resolves packaged IPC and Perl without host PATH
unset agent resolves the packaged menu without selecting an agent
offline product catalog resolves installed registry and runtime tools
notification jq/busctl resolve before the deliberately absent bus
cache purge resolves packaged find/hash tools and preserves unrelated files
command presence retains the declared host program boundary
packaged agent setter/reader share isolated XDG state and resolve atomic file tools
packaged agent launcher preserves prompt argv at the recorded application boundary
retired OpenClaw and Hermes selections/stubs cannot install, launch or alter state
invalid agent installation request preserves selection without invoking an installer
fresh terminal/editor default readers need no workstation state
terminal launch resolves packaged cwd/setsid with recorded host facilities
packaged editor setter/config launcher share owned state despite unavailable toast bus
terminal selector writes only the configured XDG destination
terminal and inline editor routes resolve packaged sibling helpers
presentation runs packaged bash/logo/done without reinterpreting argv
browser resolver reads XDG desktop provider and preserves static argv
browser default reader uses packaged XDG tools and isolated MIME handlers
webapp launch resolves packaged XDG/resolver/jq/setsid and retains literal URL argv
focus wrappers resolve same-output helpers and record the host Hyprland boundary
browser launch resolves packaged tools before the deliberately unavailable user bus
probes.limits: Recorded host IPC and unavailable buses; no live desktop or clean-host installation proof.
